The equation of the digital measure

monospline_act.Rd

`monospline_act()` builds the curve object used everywhere in the package: `list(mu = function(eta), sigma = sigma(0), log_sigma = c(g0, g1) or NULL, range, beta, type)`; `ispline_act()` builds the same object for a curve fitted with `fit_ms(curve = "ispline")`. `mu_sqi()` and `sigma_sqi()` evaluate the mean \(\mu(\eta)\) and the residual SD \(\sigma(\eta)\) (constant, or \(\exp(g_0 + g_1 \eta)\)).

Usage

ispline_act(beta, interior, order, sigma, log_sigma = NULL)

monospline_act(beta, sigma, log_sigma = NULL)

mu_sqi(eta, act)

sigma_sqi(eta, act)

Arguments

beta

24 non-increasing spline coefficients

interior, order

`ispline_act()`: interior knots and I-spline order of an I-spline fit (`fit_ms(curve = "ispline")`); `beta` are then the non-increasing B-spline coefficients of order `order + 1` on those knots.

sigma

constant residual SD (ignored when `log_sigma` is given)

log_sigma

`c(g0, g1)` for the log-linear SD, or NULL

eta

latent values

act

a curve object
